parameters: \n<Sister Penitent> Ah, traveler, your arrival is most fortuitous. I am Ragatha, Sister-Penitent, sworn to guard this sacred ground. It seems the gods themselves have sent you to aid us

\n<Ragatha> Twenty years ago, during the Horde's last assault, we captured a host of their monstrosities. Chthonic horrors—abominations against creation—were sealed in the dungeons beneath the Church of All Gods. They remain there, festering in their darkness

\n<Ragatha> But they must be purged. Their taint cannot be allowed to linger, not any day longer. I ask you to descend into the dungeon, destroy those vile creatures, and retrieve a sacred tome from the library — a book that may hold the key to warding off Azrog-Khaan's darkness.

\n<Ragatha> Take care. The dungeon is a labyrinth of shadows, and the monsters within will test your strength and resolve. Return to me once your task is complete. The gods will surely smile upon your triumph.
What sort of vile creatures plague this place?

\n<Ragatha> Those things, I have seen them only a few times. One time in the years of my childhood, I visited this place, with my mentor, Sister Siwetha. Flesh and scales, tentacles and horns, faces not of gods’ creation, but of disgusting spawns of Old Gods. They fear light and sanctity, thus those who wish to fight them, should be protected by blessing.
Why have you chosen to guard this place?

\n<Ragatha> It was my choice. I… You can see that I am not fully of human origin. I was born of the union of a mortal woman and demon, and thus am seen as strange. Archbishop is a kind man and people in here are mostly kind to me, so it is my way to repay them. Penance for my demonic part, and place of meditation for human part.
Are you ok? How do you feel?

\n<Ragatha> Oh, thank you for asking. I am… Whom do I try to fool. It is scary in here. But… It is my duty. You are a kind person, caring even for a half-demon like me. May gods bless you in your task of purging this place…
\n<Ragatha> Please... You're the only one I can entrust this task to
